en: Saraṇaduka, Vedanāttikādi (The Couplets on Having an Object of Refuge, etc., and the Triplets on Feeling, etc.)

Dependent on a state that is non-protective and not associated with pleasant feeling … pe … dependent on a state that is non-protective and not associated with painful feeling … pe … [dependent on] a state that is non-protective and not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling … pe …
Dependent on state conditioned by way of law (*dhamma*) … (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there are five; under object condition there are two … pe … under resultant condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are five.

Dependent on state that is neither clinging nor resultant … (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five; under object condition there are two … pe … under resultant condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are five.
Dependent on a state that is non-perishing and not of a nature to ripen (*navipākadhammadhamma*) ...

dependent on a state that is non-perishing and neither-ripening-nor-of-a-nature-to-ripen (*nanevavipākanavipākadhammadhamma*) ... (Abbreviated. Under root-condition (*hetu*), two; ... under result-condition (*vipāka*), one; ... under non-disappearance-condition (*avigata*), two.

Dependent on a state that is non-perishing, not-clung-to, and not-object-of-clinging (*naupādinnupādāniya*) ... (Abbreviated. Under root-condition, five; under object-condition (*ārammaṇa*), two; ... under result-condition, one; ... under non-disappearance-condition, five.
Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor subject to clinging, [arises a state] … Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor not subject to clinging, [arises a state] … (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there are five; under object condition there are two … pe … under resultant condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are five.
